text:
lina: Quick sync — planning a microdeploy on the release train (wave B) tomorrow 09:30 PT. Minimal change (routing flag + small hotfix). Who can own smoke and who is rollback standby?

sam: I can take smoke for infra pieces. I’ll be online 09:20–10:00 PT.

ricardo: I’ll be rollback owner. Keep me posted when canary hits 50% so I can stand by.

anya: What exactly is in the smoke checklist? can we paste a short step list here so reviewers know expectations?

lina: Yep — quick checklist below. trying to keep it <5 min.

lina: ```
1) Verify /health and /metrics on canary hosts
2) Run a sample user flow (login -> create doc -> save) via prod-test account
3) Check latency p95 on the last 5m in tracing
4) Confirm no increase in 5xx or queue depth
5) Validate routing flag rolled out to 20% then 50%
```

kevin: tiny note — if the routing flag toggles, make sure cache flush job runs (`/jobs/flush-cache`) or we get stale routes. I can trigger if needed.

sam: LGTM. I’ll do the sample flow and health checks.

lina: Thanks. deploy-bot — schedule for 2026-03-19 09:30 PT (16:30Z) — can you create the canary window and notify owners?

deploy-bot: Scheduled microdeploy wave-B for 2026-03-19T16:30:00Z. Canary rollout: 20% -> 50% -> full. Notifying: sam, ricardo, lina.

anya: one more ask — can we add a short rollback playbook snippet here? simple commands so on-call can act fast.

ricardo: rollback steps: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/service -n prod --to-revision=<prev>` then re-enable previous routing flag and scale replicas back to previous counts. I’ll paste exact revision if we need.

lina: great. If sam gives :thumbsup: we’ll call this good and ship.

sam: :thumbsup: I’ll ping when smoke is green at 09:35 PT.

lina: perfect — thanks everyone. I’ll update the release board with owners and link this thread.
